description: This script automates code generation tasks for the ANGLE project, specifically generating build files and data dependencies for Vulkan conformance test suite (VK-GL-CTS). It manages data directories, path replacements, and creates build and gni files based on the source directory structure.

methods.name: initDataDirectories
methods.description: Initializes a list of data directories with specific subpaths related to GLES and external data sources.

methods.name: initPathReplacements
methods.description: Sets up path replacements for external data directories to adjust file paths during build generation.

methods.name: createBuildGnFile
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a build.gn file at the specified path.

methods.name: createGniFile
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a .gni file at the specified path.

methods.name: writeFileHeader
methods.description: Writes a standard header comment into a file, indicating it is auto-generated.

methods.name: fixDestinationDirectory
methods.description: Replaces parts of a directory path based on provided path replacements.

methods.name: convertPathToVarName
methods.description: Converts a filesystem path into a variable name by replacing path separators with underscores.

methods.name: getCMakeLists
methods.description: Recursively searches for CMakeLists.txt files within a directory tree.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates data directory initialization, path replacements, file collection, and generation of build and gni files based on directory structure.
